# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

<!-- cap-evolve:insights-append-below -->

## Reconcile-with-examples procedure + table/formula contracts (cand_0002)
- What worked (cand_0002 ACCEPTED +0.025): fixed 267-18 (untouched formula → cached value), 402-43 (header row on a new sheet), 45635 / 50768 (labels on both axes), 48527 (examples beat literal wording).
- What didn't (cand_0002 broke): 31628, 37456, 560-12, 80-42. All four passed under cand_0001. The stronger rules were over-applied: header placed at answer_position's top-left instead of the instruction's start cell, the target region rebuilt instead of appended to, a direct reading flipped to an exotic one, data limited to the answer rows.
- Promising but not yet confirmed: the scoped counter-clauses in cand_0003 (placement, appending, direct reading, source extent).

## Round-1 fixed dump script + only-first-block contract (cand_0001/cand_0002)
- What worked: cand_0001 (+0.350) made literal-values grading explicit. cand_0002 kept the bounded dump script, which ran on all 40 init files without error.
